description: Source code implementing 2D convolution operators in Torch's tensor expression framework, including depthwise convolution and support functions for various convolution configurations.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Represents a tensor in tensor expression framework, constructed from buffer handle and statement.

methods.name: conv2d_depthwise_static
methods.description: Performs static depthwise 2D convolution with fixed parameters, returning a tensor expression.

methods.name: conv2d_depthwise_dynamic
methods.description: Performs dynamic depthwise 2D convolution with runtime parameters, returning a tensor expression.

methods.name: conv2d_depthwise
methods.description: Overloaded functions to perform depthwise convolution with fixed or dynamic parameters, with or without bias.

methods.name: conv2dIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given depthwise conv2d configuration is supported based on tensor info and parameters.

methods.name: mkldnnPrepackedConvIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if MKL-DNN prepacked convolution is supported for given tensor info and parameters.

methods.name: computeConv2d
methods.description: Computes 2D convolution, choosing optimized depthwise implementation if supported, otherwise calls external function.

methods.name: computePrepackedConv2dClampRun
methods.description: Computes prepacked 2D convolution clamp run via external call.

methods.name: computePrepackedLinearClampRun
methods.description: Computes prepacked linear clamp run via external call.

methods.name: computeMkldnnPrepackedConvRun
methods.description: Computes MKL-DNN prepacked convolution run via external call.
